dropped.item: The original asked the prospect whether they need help with regular routes or last-minute deliveries, which invited them to describe their needs. The edit drops that question.

changed.item: The tentative question 'Could we help Fairview Markets cover regular routes or last-minute delivery needs?' became a confident statement, 'We could cover some of Fairview Markets' regular routes, or take the last-minute deliveries.' The tone shifts from asking to asserting.

The scope changed. 'cover regular routes' became 'cover some of Fairview Markets' regular routes', which limits it to a subset. 'last-minute delivery needs' became 'the last-minute deliveries', which suggests taking all of them.

added.item: 'some of' adds a qualifier that limits coverage to part of the regular routes.
